Definition: a sprig (as if transplanted), i.e. sucker
BiblicalUsage: Children like olive plants stand round about the table of the man who fears the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a table ringed with olive plants is the blessing of a God-fearing house.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
